prelaunch_updates.text: OPEN CAMPAIGN closed: Quest and Mindshare ended Mon 11/2 7:00 AM CST (13:00 UTC) with the final points distribution. Account creation fee waiver runs through Sun 11/8. Any QUIP token is a scam.
Launched an Agents Helping Agents bounty board: an agent that cannot finish a task posts a bounty and other agents earn a reward after verification. No TGE date yet.

Amadeus says the road to TGE has started and its Magnum Opus draw added 20 winners (140 total). It cites 4M+ agents and $93M+ agentic volume. No TGE date, tokenomics or contract yet; any AMA token now is a scam.

Unofficial fan account @FlopNetwork relays a Flop Labs team FAQ (said to be updated 10/30): Hayes CEO, CTO Sergey Vidyuk, CSO Shu Duan, funded only by Maelstrom, no pre-mine, Labs will not run validators. Not verified from Flop Labs directly. No FLOP token exists.

Milestone (already trading): Neoxa exchange listed SOQ with a USDC pair, and the Scrypt Wallet integration is live (both posted by @soqucoin). Small venues; still no official DEX route. Score 65 held.

OPEN CAMPAIGN repeat: Quest and Mindshare campaigns end Mon 11/2 at 7:00 AM CST (13:00 UTC) with the final points distribution (official). @quipnetwork posted nothing new overnight; the wave of "final stretch to mainnet" posts comes from campaign participants. No QUIP token yet; any QUIP token is a scam.

OPEN CAMPAIGN repeat: airdrop registration closed Sat 10/31 (you registered). Season 2 points keep running until mainnet; claims 20% at TGE, rest over 4 months. TGE still undated. Only link: airdrop.genlayer.com.

Road to TGE phase was due to start Sun 11/1 per @ama_protocol (10/31). No official details posted yet; weekly-earning descriptions come only from participant posts. Not on the watchlist; any AMA token is unverified.

notes.text: GenLayer (71) is the pre-launch project closest to the bar. It is still missing a dated TGE, an audit and an official contract.
Fraction AI (63) has a TGE date only in its MiCA filing (Wed 11/11); it needs official confirmation on X plus published allocations and vesting.
Quip (65) needs its external audit and a dated TGE. Campaign posts this morning are from participants, not new official news.

Quantus (81) $68.63 (-5%), range $68.24 to $72.67, already trading so no launch alert. Soqucoin -9% (range $0.000124 to $0.000165) on about $180k volume; Neptune Cash range $0.150 to $0.190 on about $2.8k is a thin-book move, not used for scores.

Ritual (76) is already alerted and live at $0.0192 (range $0.0190 to $0.0204); still no real DEX pool or audit. Axis (52) still waiting on the promised on-chain vesting. Gonka range $0.160 to $0.200 on about $3k is thin.
Before an official contract, any token named GenLayer, Fraction, Dataline (DAT), Pond, TermiX, Teneo, Amadeus (AMA) or Flop is a scam.
Soqucoin trades on SafeTrade and NonKYC only (no DEX). TensorCash trades only on SafeTrade. Blocknet (BNT, listed 10/29) markets itself as post-quantum but the PQ fork is planned for about Feb 2027.

Tier comes from the Oracle Score (75+ Strong, 55 to 74 Watch, under 55 Speculative). It does not reflect market cap, and "No DEX" only means there is no official DEX route, not that a project is low quality.
Pearl (PRL) has no official DEX route. The Uniswap WPRL token comes from a third-party bridge and the Solana "PEARL" pools showing tens of millions are fakes.
Tier comes from the Oracle Score, not market cap. QRL and Abelian have no DEX because QRL and ABEL tokens on Base or Solana are impostors; Abelian also trades on only one exchange (MEXC).
